name: Death Manual: Troes takes the quest back and Valerius Thorne opens no empty shop (#6118)
contract: Quest 49987 Death Manual (Reaper only, AllowableClasses 536870912) ends at Troes the Remover 50289,
who stands in Northshire Valley at -8925.75 -199.67 80.66 (rev_20260930_99) with npcflag 51
(rev_20261003_00). Valerius Thorne 501266, 1.5 yards from him, has no vendor items, no trainer and no
gossip menu; the Northshire baseline restore (rev_20260930_98) gave him npcflag 179, whose vendor bit draws
the merchant bag over a trainer that sells nothing. rev_20261007_90 restores the gossip-only flag of
rev_20260929_92. Expected: a real vendor (Brother Danil 152) opens its shop, asking Valerius for his wares
opens nothing, and in the world phase a Reaper carrying the completed Death Manual sees the turn-in marker
on Troes and can hand it in.
